title: Public landing footer has no links to Terms, Privacy, Cookies, Accessibility or contact
standards: European Accessibility Act / EN 301 549 (accessibility statement findability)
EU e-commerce information requirements (counsel to confirm)
steps: Open /landing; the footer links are Sign In, Register, Marketplace, Showrooms.
Legal pages are linked only from /login, /register (Terms, Privacy) and the signed-in Privacy settings screen.
expected: Every public page footer links to Terms, Privacy, Cookies, Accessibility statement and a contact/imprint, as expected of an international platform.
actual: A first-time visitor cannot find the policies or the accessibility statement without starting sign-up.
impact: Trust and compliance: visitors and regulators expect policies one click away from every public page.
fix: Add a shared PublicFooter with Terms, Privacy, Cookies, Accessibility (/service-agreement?tab=...), contact (mailto from lib/legalIdentity.ts) and the legal identity line; use it on landing, marketplace, showroom and auth pages.
regression_test: Playwright: /landing footer has links to each policy tab and they return 200.
